privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what information SIGMA+ Agency collects when you use this website, and how it's used.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: SIGMA+ Agency is a digital product studio. For any privacy question or request, contact us at the email address listed on our Contact page.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you submit the Contact form or Project Builder, we collect what you provide: name, email, phone (if given), company (if given), and your project details. If you use SIGMA AI, we collect the messages you send it. If you accept optional analytics cookies, we also collect anonymous usage data (pages viewed, general interactions) tied to a random session identifier — never your name, email, or message content.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: Essential cookies (needed for the site and your cookie preference itself) are always on. Optional analytics cookies are off until you accept them, and you can change your choice at any time using "Manage" in the cookie banner.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: To respond to your inquiry, prepare the proposal or service you requested, operate SIGMA AI if you use it, and understand how the site is used so we can improve it. We do not sell your information.

sections.heading: Third parties
sections.body: We use Anthropic to power SIGMA AI (only when you use that feature), an email provider to send our own notifications, and — only if enabled and only after you accept analytics cookies — Google Analytics. Each is used strictly for the stated purpose, not for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your information as long as reasonably needed to respond to your request and for legitimate business/legal purposes. You can ask us to review, correct, or delete your data by contacting us.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Depending on where you're located, you may have rights to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. Contact us and we'll respond to any request.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of the SIGMA+ Agency website.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: By using this website, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

sections.heading: The services described here
sections.body: This site describes SIGMA+'s services. Submitting the Contact form or Project Builder is a request for a proposal, not a binding contract — any real engagement is confirmed separately, directly with our team.

sections.heading: SIGMA AI
sections.body: SIGMA AI is an automated assistant. Its responses are informational and help scope your project — they are not a professional, legal, or financial guarantee, and any real proposal is reviewed and confirmed by a person before it's sent.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
sections.body: Don't misuse this site — no attempts to disrupt, scrape at scale, or attack the platform, and no submitting content you don't have the right to share.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: The content, design, and branding of this site belong to SIGMA+ Agency unless otherwise noted.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: This site and SIGMA AI are provided "as is." To the extent permitted by law, SIGMA+ isn't liable for indirect or incidental damages arising from your use of the site.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: The governing law and jurisdiction for these Terms will be confirmed before broad public launch.

sections.heading: Changes
